direct_product_source_findings.finding: Exit disconnects viewport/safe-area listeners, stops generator player, nulls engine_playback and stream, then restores window settings. No omitted player cleanup is visible in this method.

Exit kills the crossfade, stops both music and effect players, clears their streams and the stream cache. This code is identical at803e/acf51/785413; it is not evidence identifying the logged residual objects.

An intentional per-track static Sky cache exists, creating a Sky and ProceduralSkyMaterial. Its comment states a renderer workaround, but this review does not independently verify that explanation and cannot attribute the4/4/2 cached-resource warnings to these objects.
No explicit drain/assertion before quit; however the official SceneTree finalize path flushes queued deletions, so attributing the warnings solely to immediate quit would be unsupported.

findings: SceneTree::finalize (844–873) flushes the deletion queue before root deletion and again afterwards, then clears timers and tweens. quit (875–880) sets exit code and quit flag.
ResourceCache::clear (802–815) emits the number of still-cached resource paths. With --verbose it also prints each path and class; the current original logs have no such identities.

ObjectDB::cleanup (2659–2703) reports remaining objects; --verbose adds classes, instance IDs and available reference/path detail. Four warning lines mean four affected process shutdowns, not four known leaked objects.

ObjectDB is a WARNING. This explains green job acceptance without establishing clean teardown; the source comment calling the message known is not an independent causal proof.

recommended_narrow_gate_not_executed: On the final exact native source, run only these same four existing probes with --verbose and their existing respective deadlines; preserve complete exit codes and logs, including resource paths/classes and leaked-instance detail.

If identities are owned by the Kart scene or its audio, demonstrate their release after scene removal before quit; retain a bounded scene-lifecycle check rather than silencing diagnostics. If identities belong to an intentional cache, document bounded ownership and actual cleanup separately before calling it harmless.

Keep every existing gameplay assertion and the original warning evidence. Do not claim leak-free runtime or Fold7 memory stability from current PASS markers; no recommended gate was added or run in this review.
